nom: NUDESTIX NUDESKIN 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner

avis.texte: This product dries fast which is nice the bottle is bog enough to last you for a long time the smell is light and not a big fan of the smell but it's not citrus or fruity but does work I recommend washing after 5 minutes and it does really soften the skin.

Received this product complimentary from bzzagent in exchange for my honest review. It's an amazing product. It's lightweight sensitive on your skin and a gentle scent. It really does make your skin glow!

avis.titre: So so product didn't see results.
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I tried it and unfortunately was not a fan. It smelled like something someone much older would use. The product itself was light and absorbed into my skin easily. However the dispenser was an absolute pain to use without cotton pads. I don't use cotton pads because I don't want to create unnecessary waste and was surprised this brand that prides itself on a low environmental impact created this product in a way that promotes the generation of unnecessary waste. I also didn't see any improvement in my skin from regular use. I do use it for my underarms because the smell doesn't bother me as much and it helps with staying sweat free. Unfortunately this product is not for me.

NUDESKIN by NUDESTIX 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner is wow wow wow. I've been in the beauty industry 12+ years and waiting for companies to remember that we have skin below her neck. So many companies do all of these wonderful products for the face and ignore the rest of the body. Go NudeStix! I didn't expect much when this arrived. However I will tell you that my results are visibly noticeable and I have that glow back that I had in my 20s. Use this exfoliant with a cotton pad or I used it with a larger reusable face cleansing pad and while it was easy to use it also lasted longer than I expected the bottle to last. If you shave first you will definitely feel it but I won't say that it necessarily hurts. If you're super sensitive maybe don't shave the day you use this. Also if you're super sensitive maybe you don't use it as often until you build up tolerance and remember now that you're exfoliating your body. You also need to sunscreen the whole body. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

as a licensed beauty professional with over 20 years of experience working in production medical spas plastic surgery & beauty store I have much experience with ingredients and skin conditions this would benefit from. I find the fruit & acid complex to be beneficial for keratosis pilarus chicken bumps ingrown hairs and also clogged pores. Additionally they speed up skin cell turnover for brighter smoother skin. I find the ingredients to work rather instantly and also hydrate. I used this for my boyfriend's break outs on his stomach. This is even nice for under arms! The only thing I would change is making the scent a bit more noticiable so that the lavender and bergamot really do come forward.. I look forward to trying other items by Nude. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**
I absolutely love this product left my face feeling so fresh and reduced the appearance of pores and fine lines . Smells like citrus leaves skin feeling tighter

Firstly I must comment on the packaging and pump. It disperses the perfect amount onto a cotton pad so nothing is wasted. The product has a subtle not overpowering scent. Within the first week of using the toner as directed I noticed my skin had a healthy glow and looked revitalized.

I really loved this toner. It is lightweight and does not sting my skin. the toner left my skin feeling fresh and not sticky. It was gentle but effective. It minimized the appearance and texture of my skin on my problem areas.There is a light and refreshing smell of citrus. I like that the plastic packing is biodegrable. I also like the simplicity of the packing and colour. Although it is a smaller product it will last quite some time if you follow the directions clearly.

avis.titre: Surprised at how much I like it!
avis.texte: I was really surprised at how much I liked this product. I normally don't use toners because they can dry out my skin but this one never did! I used it for over two weeks to really make sure my skin wouldn't react and it never did. In fact - after double cleansing to wash my makeup away this toner still caught a bunch of makeup that my cleansers missed which made me feel much better and cleaner. The scent is really nice and I like the spout too!
This toner helped create a smooth feel on my skin and created a glow after a consistent use. My skin can get very dry sometimes and this helped with that. The smell isn't too overpowering either.

avis.titre: Light peeling after one week of use
avis.texte: I used this for one week once a day before applying moisturizer. I did feel a slight tingle upon application and if you have any healing pimples or sensitive skin this may cause some irritation at first. The tingling stopped after a couple of minutes. After a week I did notice my skin started to peel. My only concern is that I got new pimples during the peeling time one week after applying. I will keep using this product but I will avoid sensitive areas like my chin. I will try on my hand to get rid of dark discolouration caused by the sun. I would recommend this as an affordable AHA toner to gently exfoliate and easy to apply process.
Nice product that is not too harsh on my sensitive skin. It smells good but isn't overpowering. The pump is nice to use a cotton round with. It made my skin glowy and did not break me out.

avis.titre: Beautiful packaging and product can't wait to buy
avis.texte: I used this product as a toner after my cleanser and was very impressed with the overall result. Compared to other toners I've tried this one is much better in that I didn't need to put on face cream after as it left my face glowy and moisturized/very soft. The fragrance was not too overpowering of the citrus scent which I liked and would definitely purchase this and recommend to family and friends!

avis.titre: Helped with my skin texture will repurchase!
avis.texte: This helped with my skin texture especially on my cheeks I have dry patches on my cheeks but this toner didn't dry my skin or those patches. I have enlarged pores and I have noticed a actual difference. I get pimples occasionally especially when stressed out. I've noticed a difference too after using the toner so I will continue to use this toner until I have to repurchase it.

avis.titre: Gentle Resurfacing for Rough Skin Texture
avis.texte: Thank you BzzAgent for the complimentary Nudestix Nudeskin 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner with Grapefruit + Lime + Lemon + Apple + Orange in exchange for my honest review. It is made with 3% glycolic acid and 2% fruit acid complex. It also contains ingredients such as hyaluronic acid eucalyptus leaf oil peppermint oil and tangerine peel oil. The scent reminds me of a combination of citrus and eucalyptus. I pressed a round cotton pad onto the pump surface until it was saturated with toner and applied it to my cleansed face. My skin immediately felt fresh and gently exfoliated. By night time I could see that the surface layer of my skin was noticeably smoother which is very promising as I have kp (keratosis pilaris) bumps on my cheeks and this toner was effective at smoothing out the bumps. For this reason I will continue using this product.#freeproduct #bzzagent #nudestix #nudeskin #producttester #productreviewer

I received this product for free. After using the toner for a few weeks I am a fan. The scent is very light but pleasant. I found it refreshing and appreciated that it didn't linger for too long. I absolutely love the pump on the bottle - it made adding this to my routine simple and easy to maintain. The feeling on my skin was very smooth and I noticed that my skin felt healthier after a while of using it. I will definitely look at continuing with this product in the future and would recommend it to anyone looking for an easy way to add to their skin routine and skin health!

I got this product to use from bzzagent and really loved it it gave a great refreshing after feeling when I put it on. My skin did not overreact but it did hurt when I had a scar on my face. I appreciate the scent and the convenient dispenser to allow me to use it easily

Loved this product! I used it morning and night and it worked well with my other skincare products. There was an ever so slight tingle when using but nothing crazy or really that noticeable but it may be an issue if you have sensitive skin? Loved the fact this packaging had a pump on it mess free application!

This is a really nice glycolic acid toner. It feels pleasant on the skin and really does exfoliate my skin feels smooth and refreshed after using consistently. There is a scent but it is not overwhelming and fades quickly. I like the pump action as well. I received this product free to try but will definitely be purchasing it on my own.

Freshly scented gentle toner that has the right amount of acid. Great pump top that is useful when using cotton pads. I applied this product with my hands so I turned the bottle upside down and then applied pressure to the pump. It leave a slight stickiness but I believe that's from the Hyaluronic Acid.

I use this product 3 or 4 times a week and I love what it has done for my skin! I noticed that my complexion is more even and glowing. All around my skin looks and feels healthier. I even have my boyfriend using it and he likes it as well! (big surprise here; he is not a fan of any skin products but actually liked this one!)I would definitely buy this again!

This toner is an excellent addition to add to your daily skin routine. Before using this product my skin looked dull and after using it for a week I noticed such a difference in my skin. After using this toner my skin instantly looked refreshed and had more of a glow. I was very impressed by how quickly my skin started to look more toned and brighter.

I use this product after washing my face. I love the pump on this product it allows me to get the perfect amount. The product feels fresh and clean and leaves my skin feeling bright and refreshed. I haven't used a product like this in the past but I love this product. I would buy this product again and I would recommend this product to others.

avis.titre: I would probably purchase this product again
avis.texte: I enjoyed this products scent and the packaging is nice and comfortable to use.

I've used this product on my face and I've found it gentle enough to use on sensitive skin. I like the smell of it and like the way it feels on the skin when applying. It gave a nice smooth feeling to my skin and I didn't find it irritating!

I received this product for free but I will be buying it in the future! I used it every second night for 2 weeks and my skin started to glow. Doesn't sting or make my skin feel dry. The dispenser is cool and easy to use but a bit too powerful. it would often spray through my cotton pad and onto the floor. In any event I highly recommend.
This product transformed my textured skin to feel baby soft! I have fairly sensitive skin so I can only get away with using it once or twice a week until I'm able to build tolerance.
It is a really good product those people who dont want to use too many products on there face and who are busy like me can us either to fix all there skin problems .

I have used this toner for a couple of weeks. It's easy to use and can feel the exfoliation. The mix of citrus fruits extracts and glycolic acid is somethingnew for my skin. I am generally oily and acne prone. The scent is not overpowering. It aids in reducing the look of my pores and my skin texture overall improves. It leaves you with a healthy glow. I will continue using this toner on a occasional basis as my acne prone skin is hormonal and changes throughout the month. This is a product that I will have on my skincare shelf.

avis.titre: The scent and softness is everything
avis.texte: I followed the directions by using this after I did my daily cleansing routine and I could tell instantly the scent was refreshing and uplifting and it left a little tingle on the skin but ultimately it was soft and renewed. I was using a Clinique toner for the longest time but I have found a new friend in this product. I also appreciate the pump on top so I don't have to tilt the bottle and over use it. A simple pump or 2 does the trick.

There's such a difference in my skin tone and texture since I started using the Nudestix toner. My skin feels firmer and looks smoother than ever. The packaging is so cute and I love the pump! It's very easy to dispense the right amount on a cotton pad. This is it!

I have really been enjoying this product. It clarifies pores gently exfoliates dissolves impurities brightens minimizes rough skin texture and minimizes the appearance of fine lines. I use this after cleaning my skin with the cleanser. My skin feels instantly soft and looks radiant with a beautiful healthy glow. I do find it has a slightly tacky texture.

This glycolic toner was gifted to me to try. I used this for 2 weeks once a day before applying moisturizer. I did feel a slight tingle upon application and if you have any healing pimples or sensitive skin this may cause some irritation at first. The tingling stopped after a couple minutes. This has a slight citrusy scent but dissipates shortly after applying. My skin felt smooth after the first use and my moisturizer applied a lot easier afterwards. After a week I did notice my skin was glowing and my skin tone appeared more even. Though I did get a few new pimples during this time it is hard to say if it was directly from this product but something to keep in mind. Overall I would recommend this as an affordable AHA toner to gently exfoliate.

This product used with a cotton pad can get rid of any excess make up and the packaging allows you to apply the product onto a cotton pad with ease no mess. Only thing bothersome would be the scent I personally don't mind it but it changed after time to smell kind of worse.

avis.titre: I will definitely be purchasing this again!
avis.texte: I use this product after cleansing my skin. It makes my skin feel extra clean and super smooth. It is not sticky and has a nice smell. I feel like it is making my skin brighter and more energized! I will definitely recommend this to all of my family and friends!

As as toner to follow your cleansing routine this toner is very nice. It doesn't have the same tingling that some do while it does smell wonderful and assits in providing a fantastic after glow! The easy to use top is a great bonus!

I haven't used a chemical exfoliant in a while but have used many in the past. This one left a burning sensation on my skin in a way I have experienced before. However I do really like the more natural clean ingredients. Something I will probably reach for more in the winter vs summer due to the amount of sun exposure.

#nudestix#buzzfeed#smoothskin #glycolicacid I love this I have wanted to incorporate glycoliacid in to my routine for so long and this works so well. It has the cutest pump and scent free which i love cause we need no purfume in our skin care routine. Started by using to every other day slowly will make it a daily routine. If you are just introducing glycoliacid Remember to use sun screen!!

I have very dry skin so I don't normally use toners as I find them too drying for my skin; however this is the first toner I have used that I find didn't dry out my skin after using it. The citrus fruit smell is also very light and refreshing.I was using it every other day and the first few times it felt very refreshing and I got a very very subtle tingling from it (more refreshing than anything). However around the second week the tingling started growing stronger closer to a burning feeling (like when your skin is sensitive). My skin can sometimes be sensitive and I do know that it can also take time for your skin to get used to glycolic acid so I will keep using it for the meanwhile.

I liked the formulation of the product and how it sat on my skin and married with my other products. It layered nicely. I just wish it wasn't a pump dispensary as I use my toners in my hand and pat them on. Other than that I really like this product and will purchase again when finished!

This is my first time trying NudeStix's skincare. I like using a toner after cleansing and I find this one has been great so far. I love the ingredients - the cocktail of glycolic acid citrus fruit acid and husky tonic acid is amazing! It works to detox and exfoliate your skin while still supporting it with hydration. Because of the glycolic acid I had to take it slow with my sensitive skin. It seems to be adjusting nicely. My skin feels soft and plump. It smells lovely but it can be a bit tacky. Overall I really like it
I was excited to test out this product. The packaging is pretty but I don't like how to get the product out of the bottle. I rather a different opening. It left my skin feeling fresh and clean.

It's my first time using a glycolic toner and I feel like I can see a difference on my skin my skin looks more even and brighter. I do notice my skin is more sensitive to sun though so I might not use it as much during summer time. The smell is amazing!

I never tried the Nudestix brand before but have heard about it quite a lot on Tiktok. Honestly wasn't expecting much just your average toner but this left my skin feeling wonderful soft glowly and plump. I would say that I would recommend to everyone that doesn't have a sensitive skin. I also love the packaging and the dispenser. The smell is good not too strong but pleasant. I have a combination skin for reference.

I enjoyed this toner so much each time I used it I love the glow left behind. My skin feels a lot smoother and i found it helped a lot with texture and acne so far. I've been using for around 3 weeks and I love it. It doesn't sting either like other gycolic toners I have tried!

I personally would recommend this to a friend. My skin gets a little sensitive during change of season sometimes minor breakouts and blemishes. I find this toner help to calm down the skin (feels really good when taken right out of fridge) it also has good ingredients and helps to hydrate the skin
I love using this glycolic tonic before bed. When I wake up in the morning my skin looks and feels extremely soft and hydrated. Just be sure to use sunscreen in the morning.

I received this product free from Bzzagent and NUDESTIX in exchange for my honest review. I am so happy I was chosen to get this product. I have never tried anything from the NUDESTIX product line and this toner looks so intriguing. I have have combination skin so I love trying toners. Especially ones with excellent ingredients! The NUDESTIX toner is packed with some really nice ingredients such as Hyaluronic Acid %3 Glycoloic Acid and %2 Citrus Fruit Complex(grapefruit lime lemmon apple orange). I love that this toner is free from parabens formaldehydes and phthalates. Over time with daily use this toner visibly clarifies your pores exfoliates dead skin and renews your skins texture giving you a smooth and glowing complexion. I use this toner nightly after I cleanser my face. It has a nice scent that isn't too overpowering. I like that the pump on the bottle is made for more convenient use so that product isn't getting wasted. This toner is so nice and refreshing my face didn't feel dry or tight afterwards. It has helped with my oil production and definitely gives my skin a nice glow. Your face is left feeling baby soft afterwards. This product is definitely something I will be purchasing in the near future

avis.titre: Hello glow didn't know I needed you back!
avis.texte: The years go by and you end up trying so many products that it all gets confusing. It was nice to go back to basics of cleanse TONE and moisturize. I really forgot that my pores didn't have to be so large if I take care of my skin. So thank you for rejuvenating my zest for my skincare routine. I really worried that all natural wouldn't work well. But it made a difference right away my skin looked and felt smoother. So thanks for taking a jaded skin care junkie back to her enthusiast days!

avis.titre: The toner the skin care industry was missing!
avis.texte: I love that this is a clean skin care product that you can see an see the results almost immediately. This toner leaves your skin feeling soft clean and bright. I have dry sensative skin and this worked great for me and it has a light citrus smell. The packaging is awesome too! I would definitely recommend this product.

avis.titre: Never tired before but love it
avis.texte: Never used this product before I found it a little challenging to get the product out at first as the pump kept going sideways and not coming out how it should but after some playing with it I figure you have to be very precise when pressing down on the plunger. The first time it squirted all over my bathroom mirror. The container size is a nice amount of product will last for sometime. The solution wasn't drying and didn't have a strong smell. Was quite pleasant to use in my skin. I will definitely continued to use the product till it's gone and maybe I will repurchased it.

Sure I'd be happy to provide a more personalized and positive review of the 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner!I must say this toner is truly a game changer! As someone who loves to take care of their skin I've tried numerous toners in the past but this one stands out from the rest. The blend of glycolic acid and citrus fruit extracts has worked wonders in improving my skin's texture and tone. Not only does it feel refreshing on my skin but it also helps to reduce the appearance of pores and leaves my skin with a beautiful healthy glow.What's even better is that the toner is gentle on my skin and I haven't experienced any irritation or dryness. I also appreciate that it is made with natural ingredients and is free from harsh chemicals

I have super sensitive combination skin and a lot of products make my skin go wild. This product did not it left my face feeling smooth and refreshed. My face was definitely glowing. Also enjoyed the scent. Removing one star because the price is a little steap for me personally.
I use this after cleaning my face. It smells great and not too overpowering. I find it makes my skin glowy and smooth!

This toner was pretty good! It did irritate my skin when I first used it but it seemed to just be the first use. I did think it evened out my skin's texture but I didn't see my skin glowing. Maybe after more uses

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again..Amazing
avis.texte: I have been suffering from occasional skin breakouts and my face looked dull with dry patches because of the winter season. I used this product daily at night and within 2 weeks I could see a big difference. My skin felt smooth and glowing and the breakouts were minimum.

I cannot say enough great things about this product. I noticed a change after only 1 use and have not looked back since! This toner is gentle enough to use every couple of days and smells fantastic. As a bit of a skeptic I wasn't sure I would notice a difference in my skin but I was gladly proven wrong. This product was provided to me free of charge in exchange for my honest review but I will definitely be purchasing once I start running low!

I really liked the bottle with the push down dispenser. It's great when you tend to knock things over a lot because it will not spill. The toner itself is very mild and in no way could replace a proper peel but it's mild enough for daily use. I did not use it to remove eye makeup because glycolic acid is not safe around the eyes.

I recently tried this product and loved the way it left my skin feeling. It is extremely easy to apply and you can see the results almost immediately. After use my skin looked bright and toned while also feeling hydrated and smooth. This is a vegan product that actually works very well. I would definitely recommend this product.

This was my first time using a toner like this and I liked it! While I felt that it did help to renew my skin it did feel softer to the touch after application however in the long run I don't think that it helped to improve the dryness of my skin. Other than that I do feel that my skin looked brighter and more glowy. The only other thing I was slightly concerned about was limiting sun exposure while using this product so this might be better for the winter months.

I've used Korean AHA products and love them. I don't have too much acne but I know how effective these products can be. Overall I liked this one but my only complaint is with the applicator. I used a reusable bamboo pad and pressed down but the product still went all over my counter. Other than that good products.

avis.titre: Cleared my skin up in only a couple weeks
avis.texte: I noticed a difference after the first use but now that I've been using it for around a month I've noticed a significant difference. I haven't changed anything else about my skincare routine but even when I would normally get acne around the time of my period I haven't gotten any breakouts. It's a bit difficult to apply if you put it on toilet paper or makeup pads then your skin but I just make sure my hands are clean and I apply it directly to my skin after I wash my face and then rub it in that way. I texted my mom right after I got it and asked her to buy this for my bday I absolutely love it. Especially after a night out I've found it prevents any pore clogging and new acne from forming. I use this on backne as well and it's cleared everything up so far.
Leaves skin feeling soft clean and refreshed. Is gentle and I love the citrus smell. The pump type dispenser is awesome.
I used this product anytime I needed a refresh and it worked great! It made my skin glow and feel clean. I would recommend this product!

I love the thought that went into this product including the biodegradable package and the pump dispenser and the fact that the ingredients are vegan alcohol-free and cruelty-free. There's a very mild citrus scent but hardly noticeable. I don't consider my skin particularly sensitive but I did notice a mild tingling sensation for a few moments after applying it to my skin. I do think that it makes my skin glow and look healthier overall.

I really enjoyed using this toner. It left my face with a refreshing clean finish and natural glow. I have been using an Olay Cleanse Toner for the past year and have had no complaints with it but I prefer this toner since it has the added benefit of the glycolic and citrus fruit acids which help exfoliate the skin. This toner has everything I've been looking for including no parabens sulphates phthalates and alcohol. Even though the cost of this toner is way more than the Olay it's worth the cost. This is my new fave. Please Note: I rec'd this product in exchange for the post.

This product felt so good on my face and left it feeling smooth. I have a lot of issues with products since my skin is sensitive but I had no issues with this one. I'm super excited to try their other products.

This toner from NUDESTIX is amazing! With the citrus and glycolic acid combination it leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth. It's easy to use gentle on your skin and smells great! I've been using this toner for a few weeks and have noticed a significant change to my skin's texture. My skin looks so refreshed! I also love that it comes in recyclable packaging it's one of the first things I noticed. This is a new favourite and I've recommended it to friends. Without a doubt this toner from NUDESTIX is a great exfoliant to add to your regular skin routine! It's been added to my skin routine permanently.

I really liked trying this toner. It smells amazing and really refreshed my skin during my morning skincare routine. I felt that it made my pores appear smaller and my skin was glowing afterwards! I highly recommend to anyone with sensitive combination skin. I've already recommended this toner to some of my friends and they love it after purchasing it! Will be using this as a part of my everyday skincare.

I've always wanted to try a glycolic acid but wasn't sure since my skin seems to hate any product changes and always breaks out. I went into this completely unsure but I have absolutely 0 regrets! I only use it once a week before bed for now and my skin has noticably improved in the month I've been using it. It's glowier the occasional zit is no longer and the texture has improved a bit. It's caused no sensitivity/dryness despite my cheeks being a bit sensitive.The only complaint I have is I prefer to apply facial products with my hands but it's one of those push down pump bottles so I have to use a cotton round. I'll definitely be re-purchasing this once I run out though!
This was a really great & gentle product. I used to day and evening to tone my face. It wasn't overly drying as I'm a dryer skin type. I did notice my skin looking brighter after only a few uses.
This is a really effective and gentle toner that's super fun to use and smells great!

I have previously used glycolic acid toners that were too harsh on my skin and left my skin irritated so I was a bit unsure about this toner before using. But surprisingly it was gentle enough for my sensitive oily acne prone skin not to cause any irritation. At the same time I noticed the texture of my skin got better. I am using it twice in a week at night after cleansing. It has very mild pleasant smell that I liked. The only thing I did not liked was the cap of the bottle that is push down so I have to use a cotton pad to apply it. I usually prefer hands to use any toner (less landfill). I would recommend this product.

I received this as a free product. I usually use toners in my skincare routine. I found it best when applied after cleansing/washing my face. It is refreshing and helps remove any makeup left behind after cleansing. It is very lightly citrus scented. The applicator was like a pump and it worked fine. Overall not a bad product.
I use it in my CTM routine at night. And this has been an essential part in that. It does works from day 1 and results are noticeable.

avis.titre: A Perfect Addition to My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I've been using this product every day for almost a month and I love it! It's a AHA but it's not irritating and my skin handles it pretty good. I have acne prone skin as well as uneven tone/acne marks and this toner really reduced the appearance of it.

I am a firm believer in using peels to revitalize my skin however at a cost of $200+ per session it is not always possible especially right now. Toward the end of the winter my skin becomes dry and flaky and I have tried sooo many different moisturizers serums and other products to help combat the dryness to no avail. I find the only way to truly get rid of problem dry skin this time of year is to have a professional peel. This product has seemed to help since I have used it (I have only used 1/4 of the bottle so far). I have noticed a definite improvement on my nose and chin by using this as directed (3 to 5 times a week). There is a lot of product for the price. My only real concern is that the application pump is not designed ideally. I find that when using the pump excess comes out. One other amazing plus is that the package is environmentally friendly.

I fell in love with the NUDESTIX 5% Citrus Fruit &Glycolic Glow Toner! I have normal to dry skin so I normally use exfoliants.The formula is gentle enough to use a few times a week. My skin feel soft hydrated and glowing. I recommend this exfoliating toner for anyone looking for smoother and brighter skin.

I really enjoyed this toner like a lot! I've been using harsh toners that cleansed my skin but would leave my skin dry and sometimes irritated. This toner is not that. It is super refreshing doesn't dry out your skin and really cleanses it. I felt like after I used it my skin was ready for the rest of my skin care products to be received. I'm so happy I got to try this because it's my absolute new favourite and I will be repurchasing it AND telling all my friends to buy it too!
I've been using this toner for a week now and I so far I'm liking it. It has a very fresh scent. My skin is looking smoother and brighter now too. Also shout to biodegradable and recycling packaging.

I used this product twice a week for a few weeks. I found my skin has been feeling better and actually feels cleaner. There isn't much of a smell to this product which I like. I love th√© pump on the top of the bottle as it makes it easy for me to get product on my cotton pad.

avis.titre: Now a part of my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I used this product every evening before bed and my skin felt noticeably different around day 2-3. It was hydrated and smooth. I could visually see the gunk on the cotton pad (make up and dirt) after using it which was shocking as I had been double cleansing. This is now a part of my nighttime skin routine!
This product smells so nice! It was smooth going in my face then it got really red. My daughter used this product and had no problem with it.

Nudestix kindly gave me this toner for free so that I could review it. After a few weeks of use twice a week in my PM routine on my face (T-zone area) and as a body exfoliant my skin feels refreshed clean soft and it gives an instant glow. I like the pump dispenser so that the toner can be used when it's still sitting upright on the vanity top. I apply the toner with cotton pads but you can also pump it directly into your hands.Since I have sensitive combo skin I did feel stinging when I apply on my face but not on other body areas. lt helps to clarify the pores remove any dirt and resurface bumpy texture. However I haven't noticed any major difference with my dark spots and pores size. Personally I don't really like a stinging sensation on my face so this toner is better as a body exfoliant for me. Also be mindful that this toner does contain essential oils so I won't recommend if you are sensitive to EO oils.

avis.titre: A very nice toner in a cute bottle
avis.texte: I use this toner after cleansing my face approximately once a week. avis.titre: This Should be a Go To Toner
avis.texte: I use the toner after washing up at night. There is a tingle after using but it surprisingly does not dry out my skin. I was pleasantly surprised by that.

The 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner from Nudestix is a promising addition to any skincare routine offering gentle exfoliation and brightening benefits. However one issue that I encountered while using this product was with the opening/applicator which I found to be somewhat annoying and difficult to use.Despite this minor inconvenience the toner itself is quite effective thanks to its blend of glycolic acid and citrus fruit extracts. These ingredients work together to gently slough away dead skin cells and reveal a brighter more radiant complexion. I found that the toner was gentle enough to use daily and I noticed a subtle improvement in the overall brightness and texture of my skin after incorporating it into my routine. While the opening/applicator did require some finagling to get the product out I appreciated that the packaging was compact and travel-friendly.Overall I would recommend the Nudestix 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner to anyone looking for a gentle effective exfoliating toner. While the opening/applicator could be improved the benefits of the product itself make it worth the effort.

avis.titre: Refreshing Spring Glow: My Experience with NudeSti
avis.texte: I recently tried this toner and I must say it's perfect for seasonal use. While other products may be used year-round this toner is best suited for the end of winter when the skin needs a pick-me-up. I used it to brighten my dull skin tone and it was a great way to welcome the spring. The toner did a great job of exfoliating the keratinized skin but I did experience some dormant acne coming out after application. However as part of a skin renewal routine the result was cool and I developed a healthy glow on my face. I will definitely be buying more of this toner. The bottle is compact and the dispenser is convenient which minimizes consumption. The fruity scent is pleasant and it's a pleasure to use but it's best not to overdo it. Overall I would recommend this toner to anyone who wants to renew their skin and give their face a healthy look after the winter.

avis.titre: Too harsh, not for every day
avis.texte: I purchased this because I needed to replace my previous toner that was discontinued. I should have read the "how to use" section before purchasing because I didn't realize that this is only meant to be used 3 to 5 times per week. The first time I used it with my nighttime skincare routine, my cheeks were very red and inflamed the next morning. About a week later, I decided to try it again. In addition to red cheeks, the irritation had spread to my nose and chin as well. I have never had sensitive skin, so I'm surprised that this irritated my skin so much. I think maybe this product is just too harsh for me.
